text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Come, let us begin—fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: A duel...!!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah!!
Secret Technique: Superluminal Drink
Pouring!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
S-She's so fast...!
I can barely track her with my eyes...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Not bad... In that case, I will—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Secret Technique: Raging Tempest Drink
Pour—
Yaaaah!!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: She poured so many all at once...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph, merely an application of techniques
honed through swordsmanship.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you two...
Please, do your work, more carefully.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
These are to be handed out to the guests,
after all.
—Understood?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Drink-distribut-ing is totally hype-ing
uuuuup!!
Isn't this all thanks to our awesome
helper helper SUMMER?!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Besides, it seems to have gone viral on
social media before we even realized it.
Some people even decided on a whim to come
to the festival just for the drink...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Looks like he's doing alright.
Problem is... he's a little too fired up.
Could be dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Festival Attendees
text_block_list.text:
Foooo!! My body is ready for summer!!
Whaaat!! I'm getting fired up!!
I can't wait for the live concert any
longerrrr!!!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
T-This is bad!? Everyone's way too hyped
up and losing their minds...!?
At this rate, there's gonna be a riot...—!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Everyone, please calm down—!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're sweating so much... You all
came out
to the festival despite how hot it is
today, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Festival Attendee
text_block_list.text:
Eh, yeah...! That's right, I...
I wanted to get hyped up together with
Buena-chan and the others...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so happy...!
—I was really looking forward to getting
hyped with all of you too!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I was looking forward to it so, so much...
and wanted to make this the absolute best
festival ever, so I practiced really hard
for the live performance! That's why...—!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy to see everyone getting so
hyped up, but could you please
save that energy for the live performance
itself...!

text_block_list.name: Festival Attendees
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chan...!!
Alright...!! I'll hold back...!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone!
Now, let's grab some drinks and wait until
the show starts.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Cheers... or something like that♪

text_block_list.name: Festival Attendees
text_block_list.text: Cheeeeers!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Amazing... It totally calmed down...!!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Haha, the way she handled those fans was
no joke!
That really saved us...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Man, perfect timing! You really saved me,
Buena!
Durandal, you guys too—seriously, thank
you so much!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No, please! We both share the same desire
to help our fans...
So if I was able to be of assistance,
that's all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Likewise. I was informed that someone was
in need of assistance,
and as a knight, I felt it my duty to lend
a hand and came running.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you mean someone gathered everyone
here?
Tran said something like that too, but...
who would do that—?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
We're short-handeeeed!!
Someone, heeeeeelp!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Understood, I'll be right there...!

text_block_list.name: Festival Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, it's all thanks to
doing
what you told me, Journey-san...! You
really saved me...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
—Please, raise your head.
I haven't done anything that special,
really.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"On top of your duties for the student
council,
you're also on the festival executive
committee... It must have been so tough on
you."

text_block_list.name: Festival Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, my mind just went totally blank when
the unexpected happened...
I wouldn't have been able to face the
President and the others at this rate.

text_block_list.name: Festival Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
How could I ever thank you... Oh, that
application from the Expedition Support
Committee you consulted me about the other
day, I'll personally take care of that
for—!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: My, my... That is exceedingly reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh... I see how it is.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
――Good day, Nakayama-san.
Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Or is it? When did we actually start
dancing
in the palm of someone else's hand, I
wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Nakayama-san, Journey-san! So this is
where you were!
Let's do our pre-show meeting, and—...
huh?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"......Thank you for going out of your
way, Buena-san.
Let us be on our way. It would be rude to
keep them waiting."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
――Um, were you two... in the middle of an
important conversation?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Ha. It ain't something you need to
concern yourself with.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The guests seem totally energized now.
Thank goodness...
Our hard work together really paid off!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Man, so many people really helped us
out...
I gotta make sure to go around and thank
them all later.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's party! An after-party!
We'll gather evvveryone who helped out and
have a big toast☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that sounds great! Let's invite the
person who gathered all the helpers too...
Wait, it's almost time for the
show――――let's go!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You bastards!! It's finally showtime!!
Let's go! We're gonna make this the most
hype summer evvver――――!!

text_block_list.name: All 4
text_block_list.text: 『UMA Summer』！！！！
